title: Hydro Flask Insulated Mug for Coffee, Tea, Hot Chocolate - Leak-Resistant Lid, Keeps Drinks Hot
description:
About this item
INSULATED MUG: The Hydro Flask stainless steel insulated mug keeps drinks hot for hours. Sized for the perfect cup with a closeable, leak-resistant and splash-resistant lid
HOT STAYS HOT: Thanks to the double-wall vacuum insulation, drinks stay hot or cold for hours in this mug. The TempShield insulation ensures the perfect temp, so your drink is always ready for the next sip
LEAK-RESISTANT: The closeable leak-resistant and splash-resistant press-in lid on the insulated Mug keeps drinks ready to sip
SOFT TO THE TOUCH: The soft-touch exterior stays cool and is easy to hold. The ergonomic handle is strong and durable, and ensures a comfy fit."
PURE TASTE: Durable pro-grade stainless steel ensures pure taste and no leftover flavor transfer. So, today's tea have any taste of yesterday's coffee
› See more product details
reviews_5s:
I like my coffee hot, and this does the job. Keeps my coffee nice and hot for a long, long, long time -- and that's without using the lid! When I use the lid, it stays hot even longer. In fact, it feels like when the lid is on, my coffee gets even hotter, if that's possible. The size is perfect for my morning cuppa - not too much and not too little. It's a very comfortable mug to use as it fits my hand well. As far as cleaning, I have to use bleachy water to remove the stains. Using dish soap or cleaning via dishwasher doesn't cut it.Awesome mug overall! I love how big it is. No going back for seconds. It has crazy insulation, this thing will be piping hot for minutes and nothing on the outside. It has a soft and gently design, both figuratively and literally, and fits into any calm or peaceful setting. In case you're wondering the metal rim there is so you touch something definitely cooler than what's in the mug. It's also smooth and clean to the touch. Yes my one complaint is that you can't microwave it. I have an electric kettle that warms to boiling in like a minute, so it doesn't bother me. But yeah, microwave~Ordered this for my mom because she loved mine so much.

I've had mine for a year and a half and it still looks good as new, and I use it multiple times a day for my teas and coffees.

It's incredibly good quality, very durable, it's a very good size (we got the 24oz), keeps hot drinks hot for about 5 hours, the walls are not very thick and it's very lightweight. I haven't had any problems with the rubber seal of the lid leaking (but, of course, if you tip it over, drink with spill out of the drinking hole as the sliding cover in the lid is not waterproof sealed)

Love my Hydro Flask so much!!There’s so much to love about this mug!

While it’s on the pricey side, it’s backed by a 5-year warranty.

And the only real competitor in its class is Yeti. But I didn’t like Yeti’s colors or clear plastic lid.

Actually, Stanley had one but there is no way to close the lid which is wild. And the only alternative I could find didn’t have any warranty info in regard.

I bought this mainly to use at home to replace my coffee mugs so when I have extra coffee, I can plop it in the fridge and it has a cover.

The shape, it’s easy to clean.

Handle was a must for me too.

The color, I splurged and got the green agave which is gorgeous, earthy and muted. I love it! Plus, the cover matches the rest of the mug too and the lid comes apart so it’s easy to clean.

Drawbacks, I’m pretty sure it won’t fit in a car cupholder and it’s a little heavy but that speaks to the quality more than anything.This mug version isn’t leak proof, like other versions, such as water bottles. The lid pushes down. A thumb slide reveals the lid’s opening. The handle placement & style is comfortable. It’s available in 3 sizes. It’s comes in various colors. It’s easy to clean & extremely functional. Another recommended product from this company.I love this mug, it's big and perfect for instant noodles while travelling. it's a great size, the outer shell is plastic and I actually like it here, feels nice and sturdy. the lid is interchangeable with the big hydro flask 40oz tumbler. definitely not leak proof. color is great as expected for trillium.Holds 22oz of coffee hot for two hoursI really love this stainless steel mug! I’m constantly in and out of airports and I misplaced my black and silver Hydro flask, coffee mug. So, I had a good reason to get another.

I chose this 24 ounce mug because I wanted to try one with a handle. It took me a while to decide because I couldn’t quite tell what size it was from the photos and even the measurements. This 24 ounce version is larger than what the measurement saying in the description. It’s a lot bigger than I thought, and I love it.

It will not fit in my cupholder in my car, but I knew that because of the handle. What I was hoping is that I could potentially sit it on the console or in the passenger seat and this is going to work perfectly. It’s a big old mug, has a wide base, And the sides have this soft touch feel that my other Hydro flasks do not have. I’ll be honest with you, I just got it, washed it and brought up some Republic of tea and I’m currently using it. I cannot currently speak to how long it keeps things hot but if it’s anything like my other mug, it will be sufficient.

It doesn’t take me all day to drink my coffee, so I don’t need something as good as a yeti for every day, I just need something that’s comfortable in my hands, a good size, and that has a stable bottom. I think this is going to fit the bill very well! I’m really clumsy and prefer to have a totally leak proof mug, but when the slider is closed, this will work just fine for me running around at work.

I posted a picture of it in case it helps. You decide what size you want. Again, I got the 24 ounce.Keeps coffee hot for a long time even with the lid off, the color is unique and the texture is grippy. The only downside is that it doesn't fit in the car cup holder.Wife absolutely LOVES her mug !!!
reviews_1s:
Well I had really high hopes for this mug, unfortunately I have had few issues with the quality of it. For starters it doesn’t keep hot drinks hot for very long, it is not leak proof, and the outer cover (shell) to the mug has separated from the stainless steal part of the mug. I have only had this mug for just over a month, and I’m Super sad because I have been waiting for them to make a mug this size. Maybe mine is just a defective one and no one else experiences this.Nice look and feel but if you're wanting to keep your coffee/tea hot for some period, this isn't the mug. Not sure how it works for cold liquids but for hot - it's barely warm after just over an hour. Compared to my CONTIGO travel mug which keeps my coffee HOT for many hours. Insulating capacity is horribleThe overall feel and look of the Hydro Flask is great. I could not be happier with that aspect. I didn't need a leakproof cup because I am using this for my office and as long as there is some lid that stops most spills I am fine with it. What I needed was a cup that can keep my coffee hot for hours. I like most people who drink hot beverages want it to stay hot for as long as possible. This flask fails miserably at this. Within a span of 2 hours and my coffee is lukewarm to cold!? Honestly, I have other no-name brands that outperform this by leaps and bounds. If you are looking for an insulated mug to keep your coffee hot then look elsewhere!Not only does the liquid slash out of the top if you’re not careful to keep it completely upright, for example when I’m walking to my car in the morning and I have my lunch bag, my purse and water bottle, if it tips to the side in the slightest, my tea comes out the little steam vent hole.

The worst part is it only keeps my drink warm for 2 hours maximum. I tested and timed it three days in a row. I’m annoyed and disappointed because it’s a great brand, so I expected more.I typically love these. But I’ve only had it for one month and it already won’t keep my drinks hot. It’s like it lost or doesn’t have a good seal. Bummer. Guess I’ll stop buying them.it leaks .i would not recommend. it will spill your drinkI purchased this cup a couple of months ago, and it started leaking shortly after the 30-day return period ended. Although the leak is not severe, it occurs unexpectedly, causing coffee to spill on my white shirt during company meetings. I noticed that the top does not completely seal; there is always a small section that I cannot push in all the way. After a few spills, I figured out a workaround: if I press down on the side I am drinking from, the cup won't spill. While the other side remains unsealed, it doesn't matter because I don't drink from that side. However, this is inconvenient, and I shouldn't have to use the cup in this way.

Now, I have to go through the warranty process, which requires me to cover the return shipping cost. I am disappointed with this purchase and regret buying this brand.There's a tiny hole in the lid, so the liquid leaked out the first time I used it. Why is this not totally sealed?
Pretty useless if you want to transport it in the car - it doesn't fit in the cupholder, and when I placed it on the floor, it of course tilted over and the liquid leaked out of the hole.Was looking for a big mug that doesn't tip over easy. The rounded bottom plus heavy handle, makes the mug very easy to tip over. I push my tool cart to my work area and my other mug was always tipping over. Ordered this one thinking a large short mug would do better. The rounded base on this mug, isn't good for helping it from tipping over. Going with yeti 24oz.I was looking for a good coffee mug for work and decided to spend a good buck for one. So I decided to get this one but it is not good at all. It spills and gets cold very quickly. Then the coffee stains the top part of the lid. Do not recommend.
